ops.old_text:
The paired-initialization control
uses a second source-trained initialization of the reference architecture and
provides a same-architecture control for source-initialization effects.
ops.new_text:
The paired-initialization control adapts both source-trained A57 candidates on
the same support set and applies the same relative-margin rule at each $\tau$ to
select one using validation loss. The selected model's check-set loss is the
paired-control denominator; because the two source-training recipes differ, this
is a same-architecture selection control rather than a random-seed-only
comparison.
NAS-related labels denote task-matched control implementations, not exact reproductions of published algorithms.

ops.old_text:
The reference-only and two-reference-initialization variants
do not reproduce the cross-architecture gain.
ops.new_text:
The reference-only and two-reference-initialization variants do not reproduce
the gain of the complete heterogeneous-bank pipeline.

ops.old_text: The cross-architecture gain remains sensitive to source training.
ops.new_text: The heterogeneous-bank pipeline gain remains sensitive to source training.

Channels & Ten raw fields: CPU cores, capacity, MHz usage and percent usage; memory capacity/usage; disk read/write and network received/transmitted throughput. Add trailing-five CPU mean and first difference, their 12 corresponding validity masks, and preceding elapsed seconds/1,200.
